# Lana Tutors

> Lana Tutors connects parents and students with verified Kenyan teachers for one-on-one tutoring, online or in person, across CBC (now also called CBE), KCSE (8-4-4), IGCSE, A-Level, IB and American curricula. Based in Nairobi, Kenya, serving families in Kenya and across the African diaspora (UK, USA, Canada, UAE and beyond).

Lana Tutors is a Kenyan tutoring platform. Tutors are verified classroom teachers, many of them KCSE examiners or markers from leading Kenyan schools. Lessons are one-on-one over Google Meet, or in person at home in Nairobi; in Mombasa and Kisumu, in-person lessons are arranged when a tutor is nearby, and online lessons are always available. Lessons run between 6 AM and 10 PM East Africa Time (EAT, Africa/Nairobi). Families pay by M-Pesa or card, and families abroad can pay in USD, GBP or EUR.

## Key facts
- Founded and based in Nairobi, Kenya
- Kenyan curricula (CBC/CBE and KCSE/8-4-4) and international curricula (IGCSE, A-Level, IB, American/AP)
- Verified tutors only: credential-checked classroom teachers, including KCSE markers
- One-on-one online lessons via Google Meet; in-person lessons at home in Nairobi, and in Mombasa or Kisumu when a tutor is nearby
- Serves Kenyan and African families abroad in the UK, USA, Canada, UAE and Australia
- Free 20-minute Academic Assessment Call with a learning coordinator before committing to a tutor; most families are matched within 48 hours
- Custom Learning Plans designed by senior educators
- Group classes and December holiday classes
- Pricing depends on the curriculum, the level and the tutor; a learning coordinator explains it on the free assessment call. Group classes start from KES 400 per hour.
- Contact: info@lanatutors.africa, WhatsApp +254 117 512316
